summary: Order in Petition No. 75/MP/2023 Page 1 of 13 - _b) Grant liberty to the Petitioner to claim Energy Charges from the Respondent No. 1/ TANGEDCO in future, in the event there is differential recovery of such ECR which accrues to the Petitioner pursuant to adjudication of Petition No. 161/MP/2022, which is presently adjudication before this Hon'ble Commission;_ Order in Petition No. 75/MP/2023 Page 2 of 13 - _d) Pass such other further order(s) as the Hon’ble Commission may deem just in the facts of the present Petition.”_ Order in Petition No. 75/MP/2023 Page 3 of 13 7. Aggrieved with the Respondent No. 1’s letter, the Petitioner approached the Commission, vide Petition No. 349/MP/2022 dated 1.12.2022, seeking to quash the said demand letters and to direct the Respondent No. 1 to abide by the terms of the Ministry of Power’s notification and to adhere to the energy charge rate notified by the Ministry of Power in procuring the power from the Petitioner till 31.12.2022. Order in Petition No. 75/MP/2023 Page 4 of 13 - d) The Petitioner has also sought liberty to claim Energy Charges from the Respondent No. 1 in the future, in the event there is differential recovery of such ECR which accrues to the Petitioner pursuant to adjudication of Petition No. 161/MP/2022, which is presently under adjudication before this Hon'ble Commission. 11. The Petition was first heard on 10.5.2023, and after hearing the submissions of the Petitioner, the Commission admitted the matter and directed the parties to file their replies and rejoinder, if any. Respondent No.1 filed a reply on 31.5.2023. The Petitioner filed a rejoinder on 31.5.2023. Subsequently, the Petition was heard on 20.3.2024 and reserved the order on 22.8.2024. Order in Petition No. 75/MP/2023 Page 5 of 13 Order in Petition No. 75/MP/2023 Page 6 of 13 - g) On 19.12.2022, the Ministry of Power replied to the Petitioner’s letter dated 25.11.2022, wherein the Ministry of Power specifically referred to Para 4(h) of the said directions. Respondent No.1 vide its Bill Dispute Notice dated 10.2.2023, disputed the invoice for the month of December 2022. - a) The Petitioner has submitted that they denied the contention that the Respondent was vested with the discretion to either procure or not to procure power in terms of the directions. If the Respondent No.1 decides to procure Order in Petition No. 75/MP/2023 Page 7 of 13 - c) The Petitioner has submitted that the Respondent No. 1 has failed to appreciate that the Directions issued by the Ministry of Power, which are statutory in nature, have resulted in modification of the terms of PPA (including applicable tariff/ energy charge rate) executed between the Petitioner and the Respondent No.1. Order in Petition No. 75/MP/2023 Page 8 of 13 - h) The present Petition is very well within the Jurisdiction as submitted by the Petitioner, as the directions are a scheme which involves inter-state generation, as per Clauses 4(h) and 2(c) of the Directions dated 5.5.2022 and 20.5.2022 respectively, which allows the generator to supply the power to third parties, in Power Exchange. 16. We have considered the submissions of the Petitioner and Respondent No.1 and perused the documents on record. The present petition has been filed by the Petitioner seeking direction for payment of the electricity supplied during December 2022 in terms of the liberty granted by the Commission. Respondent No.1 has raised the issue of the jurisdiction again, which was already decided by the Commission in the order dated 23.12.2022 in Petition No. 349/MP/2022. Hence, the same is not dealt with again. Order in Petition No. 75/MP/2023 Page 9 of 13 10. Insofar as the aspects of TANGEDCO having already scheduled the power from the Petitioners from 1st December, 2022 onwards and applicable rates for such supply as raised during the course of arguments, we are of the view that such aspects are beyond the subject matter of these Petitions and it would not be appropriate to stretch the scope Order in Petition No. 75/MP/2023 Page 10 of 13 of these cases beyond what have been prayed for by the Petitioners. In case of the any grievances in relation to the charges to be payable by/receivable Page 8 Order in Petition Nos. 349/MP/2022 & 350/MP/2022 from TANGEDCO for such supply by the Petitioners during the subsistence of direction of MoP, the Petitioners are at liberty to approach the Commission with fresh Petitions and contentions of both the sides, on these aspects, are kept open. However, both parties, the Petitioners and TANGEDCO, are directed to scrupulously comply with the direction issued by MoP under Section 11 of the Act read with subsequent clarifications thereto as long as they are in force.” Order in Petition No. 75/MP/2023 Page 11 of 13 Order in Petition No. 75/MP/2023 Page 12 of 13 Order in Petition No. 75/MP/2023 Page 13 of 13
title: Petition under Section 79 and Section 11(2) of the Electricity Act, 2003 read with Regulation 111-113 of the CERC Conduct of Business Regulations, 1999 seeking recovery of Energy Charges from Respondent No. 1/ TANGEDCO for the power procured in the month of December, 2022, in terms of the Directions issued by the Ministry of Power, Government of India. M/s Coastal Energen Pvt Ltd.
